svg.title: Alon Baron — Software Developer · CS student · heading toward DevOps
svg.desc: Light-mode editorial architecture banner for Alon Baron: Software Developer, CS student, heading toward DevOps. Features a frosted glass hero card on #F6F7FB alabaster, 3D cybernetic porcelain sculpture, and three metric bento cards (Medusa Dynamics + TenderTrack, NUMRA, PawPals; alon-skills v3.2.2 + workflow-watch 0.4.1; and 19/19 passing evals on Fable 5.1).

g.text: SOFTWARE DEVELOPER · CS STUDENT · HEADING TOWARD DEVOPS
Build the model. Define the rules. Then write the code.
Shipping production software for real users and open-source tooling measured with evals.
